defect.scope: The explicit opt-in continuation accepted a nonempty PAYMENT-RESPONSE string without decoding or binding it to the normalized result. Demonstrated with an injected SDK-SHAPED declared-DATA capability, not an actual SDK producing a corrupt header or an active CLI/live-payment exploit.
defect.baseline: One native registration reproduced a successful normalized reply for the original hash accompanied by a wire header for a different hash. That one passed reproduction is UNSAFE behavior, not safety qualification.
defect.fix: Reuse the existing bounded canonical-base64/strict-UTF8 JSON codec and selected settlement normalizer. Require wire/result responseJson, disposition and declared publication metadata to agree under the original binding before returning the header.
defect.sourceDependencies: Import two existing exports from x402-wire.js; no dependency file or installed package was changed or newly installed.
defect.uncertainty: A faulty reply may arrive AFTER the existing reconciliation. Refusal closes the continuation as UNKNOWN, releases its explicit references and preserves the already consumed authority. It does not undo or prove the underlying settlement, clear historical uncertainty, refund, renew the budget, re-verify, re-sign, replace, or create another first settlement.
defect.defaults: Frozen-DATA default factory and active buyer/server/CLI defaults are unchanged by source review.
